OBJECTIVE: Resolve the control-P0 denominator deadlock without hiding product P0 findings or mass-closing historical evidence.
PROJECTION_INPUT: Complete canonical FINDINGS manifest; every source row retained with source path/blob provenance.
DETERMINISTIC_RULES: A P0-class row is in CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 when applicability=CURRENT and domain is CONTROL_PLANE, or domain=MIXED with independently evidenced PREACTIVATION_AUTHORITY_BLOCKER impact.

A pure PRODUCT_IMPLEMENTATION or DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE row with no control-authority impact is excluded from CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 without changing its original finding status; it remains in product/deployment accounting.
A finding superseded by an explicit active-law/control supersession record projects EFFECTIVE_CONTROL_STATUS=SUPERSEDED with that record as evidence; preserve the original source finding unchanged.
If applicability, domain, or control impact is UNKNOWN or conflicting for a P0-class row, project CONTROL_P0_ELIGIBILITY=BLOCKING_PENDING_CLASSIFICATION so zero cannot be proven by omission.
Terminal nonblocking effective statuses are only RESOLVED, CLOSED, SUPERSEDED unless a canonical schema explicitly adds another terminal nonblocking value.
OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT counts current eligible rows whose EFFECTIVE_CONTROL_STATUS is not terminal nonblocking, including BLOCKING_PENDING_CLASSIFICATION.

Generate a projection manifest over every source finding row first, then derive CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH from eligible rows; never derive the denominator from only rows already believed to be control findings.
Sort canonical projection rows by UTF-8 canonical SOURCE_PATH bytes then FINDING_ID then SOURCE_BLOB_SHA before JCS hashing.
VALIDATION: Every complete finding-manifest row maps to exactly one projection row.
No source finding disappears because classification is uncertain.
Product P0 rows are not forced closed to reach activation.
Legacy-only defects require explicit supersession evidence before becoming nonblocking.
OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0 is claimable only after the complete projection has zero blocking/unknown eligible rows.
REQUEST: Use as a review candidate only; adopt, reject, or refine under the existing semantic-classification and denominator claims with evidence.
